heroContentContract.headlineSource: data/homepage-content-claims-map.json#hero-promise; proposed positioning is not approved storefront copy.

heroContentContract.mediaRequirement: First-screen product or workshop media that is rights-cleared, crop-reviewed, alt-reviewed, dimensioned, and performance-approved.
heroContentContract.imageFallbackBehavior: Use no image or a governed non-hero fallback only if the approved content model explicitly allows a text-first hero.
heroContentContract.noMediaFallback: Do not render a redesigned hero. Keep the current neutral rich-text intro until media and copy approvals are available.
heroContentContract.mobileSequencingExpectation: Headline, supporting copy, primary commerce action, secondary support action, and next useful path must remain visible or reachable without horizontal overflow or CTA clipping at 360 px and wider.
heroContentContract.firstScreenHeightExpectation: Future first screen must not consume the viewport with dead vertical space; the next useful path should be visible or reachable with one normal first scroll across supported viewports.
heroContentContract.accessibilityExpectation: Implemented hero must provide the single semantic page h1, named CTAs, informative alt text for informative media, decorative treatment for decorative media, visible focus, and source-order keyboard traversal.
performanceConstraints: Follow data/brand-performance-budget.json homepage runtime LCP, CLS, TBT, transfer, request-count, image, and first-screen media limits.
heroContentContract.successMeasure: Future preview evidence shows customers can identify Rhino's storefront purpose and choose a valid first-screen path without unsupported claims or media/performance blockers.
blockerReasons: No launch-ready first-screen product or workshop media.
